info.title: Aarogyam API
info.description: The clinic platform's API. The clinic comes from the host name.

get.summary: Appointments starting on the clinic's local days `from` to `to`, cancelled ones included.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last local day, `YYYY-MM-DD`; at most 31 days counting both

400.description: Bad dates, ids, or a range over 31 days

post.summary:
Books an appointment. Two active bookings can't overlap in one chair (`409`); a doctor
booked in another chair at the same time, on leave, or outside their hours is allowed, with
`warnings`.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

409.description: The chair is already booked for part of this time

patch.summary: Moves, reassigns or edits an appointment that isn't completed, cancelled or a no-show.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such appointment in this clinic

409.description: The appointment is finished, or the chair is taken

post.summary:
Moves an appointment along: booked → confirmed → arrived → in the chair → completed, or
cancelled (with a reason) or no-show before arrival. Arriving issues the branch's next queue
token for the clinic day.

400.description: Unknown status, a move the table doesn't allow, or a cancel without a reason

404.description: No such appointment in this clinic

get.summary: Streams a file through a signed link from `GET /attachments/{id}/download`. The link is the proof of access, so no sign-in header is needed (an `` can use it); it works on the clinic's own host for five minutes, and every use is written to the access record.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The signed token from the download link

200.description: The file, with its media type

403.description: The link has expired; ask for a new one

404.description: Not a valid link for this file on this host

get.summary: Issues a five-minute download link for a file. Opening the link writes the access record.

404.description: No such file in this clinic

get.summary: Lists every clinic with member and patient counts.

404.description: Not the console host

post.summary: Creates a clinic and invites its owner. Owner and onboarding staff only.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

409.description: The subdomain is taken

get.summary: Service health: API, database and edge.

post.summary: Signs in as a seeded person (local development only).

Imports patients from CSV. Preview checks every row like a registration; commit registers
the valid rows in one transaction with numbers from the clinic's sequence, keeps
`file_number` and `legacy_id` as identifiers, and records the import and each row's result.

400.description: The file or mapping can't be used; the message says why

post.summary:
Delivers due outbox messages across clinics (local development only; later Cloud
Scheduler with a Google-signed token).

Accepts an invitation. The person must have signed in with the email address it was sent
to; each invitation works once and expires after seven days.

404.description: Unknown, used or expired invitation

409.description: The invitation is for another email address

get.summary: Leave overlapping the local days `from` to `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last local day, `YYYY-MM-DD`; at most 31 days counting both

400.description: Bad dates or a range over 31 days

post.summary: Records a doctor's leave. Bookings already made stay; new ones get a warning.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such doctor in this clinic
No such leave in this clinic

get.summary: The signed-in person's clinics, for the clinic switcher.
Where the signed-in person is signed in: their sessions that are neither revoked nor expired.

post.summary: Signs one of the person's own sessions out. Its next request gets `401`, on every host.

404.description: Not one of the person's sessions

patch.summary: Replaces a draft's sections. Only the author may, and only while it is a draft.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

403.description: The role lacks clinical.write, or the note is someone else's

404.description: No such note in this clinic

409.description: The note is signed; add an addendum instead

post.summary: Adds an addendum to a signed note. Addenda are never edited or removed.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such note in this clinic

409.description: The note isn't signed

post.summary:
Marks a note entered in error with a reason. It stays in the record, marked; nothing is
deleted. A draft can be withdrawn only by its author.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

403.description: The role lacks clinical.write, or the draft is someone else's

404.description: No such note in this clinic

409.description: Already marked

post.summary: Signs a draft. Only its author may; the note never changes afterwards.

403.description: The role lacks clinical.write, or the note is someone else's

404.description: No such note in this clinic

409.description: Not a draft, or every section is empty

post.summary: Marks a reading entered in error with a reason. It stays in the record, marked.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such reading in this clinic

409.description: Already corrected or marked

get.summary: The most recently registered patients.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

post.summary: Registers a patient and issues the clinic's next number.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

post.summary:
Finds patients by number, phone or name. A POST so names and phone numbers stay out of
URLs, which proxies, browsers and logs keep.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

get.summary: Opens a patient's record. Every open is written to the access record.

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

patch.summary:
Edits a patient's details with the same rules as registration. Changing the phone or email
also needs `patients.contact`. The change history records each change.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

403.description: The role lacks patients.write, or patients.contact for phone or email

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

get.summary: A patient's allergies, active and severe first.

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

post.summary: Records an allergy.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

patch.summary: Edits an allergy: resolve it, change its severity, or mark it entered in error.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such allergy for this patient in this clinic

get.summary: A patient's files, newest first.

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

post.summary:
Uploads a patient file (`multipart/form-data`, field `file` up to 10 MB). Its type is read
from its content; anything but JPEG, PNG, PDF or DICOM is refused.

400.description: Not a JPEG, PNG, PDF or DICOM file, a bad field, or a visit of another patient

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

get.summary: The patient's clinical flags: active allergies and flagged active conditions.

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

get.summary: A patient's conditions, active first.

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

post.summary: Adds a condition to a patient's problem list.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

patch.summary: Edits a condition: resolve it, flag it, correct it, or mark it entered in error.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such condition for this patient in this clinic

get.summary: A patient's dental chart, with one tooth's history when `tooth` is given.

parameters.name: tooth
parameters.description: FDI tooth number whose full history to include

400.description: Not an FDI tooth number

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

post.summary:
Records findings. Each supersedes the current entry for its tooth and surface (a crown,
implant or missing tooth also supersedes the tooth's surface entries); the history keeps
everything. Returns the updated chart.

400.description: A bad tooth, surface or finding, or a visit of another patient

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

409.description: The visit is closed, or the chart changed at the same moment

get.summary: A patient's other numbers: file number, legacy ID, smart card, ABHA.

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

post.summary: Adds a number to a patient. Each number belongs to one patient per clinic and kind.

400.description: Unknown kind or bad value

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

409.description: Another patient already has this number

delete.summary: Removes a number from a patient.

404.description: No such identifier in this clinic

get.summary: A patient's procedures, newest first.

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

get.summary:
A patient's clinical timeline, newest first: visits, signed notes, procedures and files.
Prescriptions and bills join it when they exist. Reading it writes the access record.

400.description: before isn't RFC 3339

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

get.summary: A patient's treatment plans, newest first.

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

post.summary: Proposes a treatment plan with an estimate per item.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

get.summary: A patient's visits, newest first.

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

post.summary: Starts a visit, with the caller as the clinician responsible.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

409.description: The appointment already has a visit

get.summary: The clinic's doctors, by name.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

post.summary: Adds a doctor.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

409.description: The member is already a doctor

delete.summary: Removes a doctor with no upcoming appointments, and their weekly hours.

404.description: No such doctor in this clinic

409.description: The doctor has upcoming appointments

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such doctor in this clinic

409.description: The member is already a doctor

get.summary: A doctor's weekly hours.

404.description: No such doctor in this clinic

put.summary: Replaces a doctor's weekly hours. An empty list clears them.

400.description: Bad or overlapping shifts

404.description: No such doctor in this clinic

post.summary: Marks a planned procedure done; its plan item, if any, is done too.

404.description: No such procedure in this clinic

409.description: Not planned

post.summary: Marks a procedure entered in error with a reason; its plan item is open again.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such procedure in this clinic

409.description: Already marked

get.summary: The queue of a clinic day, with each token's wait.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The clinic day, `YYYY-MM-DD`; today when left out

400.description: Bad date or id

post.summary: Issues a token to a patient without an appointment.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

post.summary: Moves a token along. A token with an appointment moves the appointment too.

400.description: Unknown status or a move the table doesn't allow

404.description: No such token in this clinic

get.summary: The clinic's roles and the permissions each holds, for choosing a role.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

get.summary: The clinic's chairs and rooms, in list order.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

post.summary: Adds a chair or room.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

409.description: The branch already has a room of that name

delete.summary: Removes a chair or room with no upcoming appointments.

404.description: No such room in this clinic

409.description: The room has upcoming appointments

patch.summary: Renames, moves, retires or reorders a chair or room.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such room in this clinic

409.description: The branch already has a room of that name

get.summary:
The clinic, member and permissions for this host. The portal hides what the role can't
do; the API still enforces it.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

get.summary:
The clinic's settings: profile, GSTIN, time zone, branding, prescription footer, address,
phone and UPI ID.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

patch.summary: Changes the clinic's settings. The change history records each change.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the setting

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

get.summary: The clinic's members, with their roles, status and branches, and pending invitations.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

post.summary:
Invites someone to the staff and emails them the link (through the outbox). Only owners
may invite owners.

400.description: Invalid email or unknown role

403.description: The role lacks staff.manage, or a non-owner invited an owner

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

patch.summary:
Changes a member's role or status. Takes effect on the member's next request. Nobody
changes their own role, only owners make or change owners, and the last active owner
can't be suspended, removed or demoted.

400.description: Unknown role or status

403.description: The role lacks staff.manage, or only an owner may do this

404.description: No such member in this clinic

409.description: Your own role, or the last active owner

get.summary:
Today's schedule, chairs, counts, appointments by hour, recent patients, the team on duty
and the attention list, in the clinic's time zone.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

post.summary: Records the patient's acceptance of a proposed plan.

400.description: A chosen item isn't a proposed item of this plan

404.description: No such plan in this clinic

409.description: The plan isn't proposed

get.summary: Opens a visit with everything recorded in it. Every open is written to the access record.

404.description: No such visit in this clinic

post.summary:
Closes a visit. Addenda and corrections still work afterwards; new notes, vitals and
procedures don't.

404.description: No such visit in this clinic

409.description: Already closed

post.summary: Starts a draft note in an open visit, written by the caller.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such visit in this clinic

409.description: The visit is closed

post.summary: Records vital signs in a visit. A closed visit takes corrections only.

400.description: An implausible value, a wrong unit, or another patient's reading

404.description: No such visit in this clinic

409.description: The corrected reading isn't final, or the visit is closed

post.summary: Records a procedure in an open visit.

400.description: Invalid input, or a plan item of another patient

404.description: No such visit in this clinic

409.description: The visit is closed, or the plan item isn't accepted or already has a procedure

get.summary: Liveness check.
get.description: Answers `ok` while the process is serving; a database outage does not fail it.

display_name.description: The name to show colleagues, when signing in for the first time.

token.description: The secret from the invitation link.

item_ids.description: The accepted items; every proposed item when left out. The others are cancelled.

Addendum.description: An addendum to a signed note.

Address.description: A postal address. Every part is optional.

substance.description: The substance, such as penicillin or latex.

verified_by.description: The member who recorded or last confirmed it.

AllergyFields.description: An allergy to record or edit. On an edit, fields left out stay as they are.

reaction.description: What happens, or empty to clear it.

substance.description: The substance, 1 to 200 characters; required for a new allergy.

AllergyList.description: A patient's allergies, active and severe first.

has_notes.description: Whether there is a front-desk note.

room_id.description: Chair or room, if booked into one.

seated_at.description: When they sat in the chair (RFC 3339).

token_number.description: The day's queue token number, once arrived.

AppointmentChanges.description:
Changes to an appointment. Fields left out stay as they are; an empty `room_id`, `reason`
or `notes` clears it. A new start without a new end keeps the length.

reason.description: Reason for the visit; empty to clear.

room_id.description: Another chair or room; empty for none.

Attachment.description: A patient file's details. The bytes come from its download link.

tooth.description: FDI number of the tooth it shows.

AttentionItem.description: Something the front desk should look at.

kind.description:
`late_arrival` (not arrived 15 minutes after the start) or `long_wait` (waiting over 30
minutes).

message.description: What to show, without patient details.

AttentionPatient.description: The patient an attention item is about.

BookingWarning.description: Something worth knowing that didn't stop the booking.

message.description: What to tell the front desk.

ChairAppointment.description: An appointment as a chair tile shows it.

status.description: `in_use` while a patient is in it, otherwise `free`.

ChartEntry.description: A finding on a tooth or one of its surfaces.

surface.description: `M`, `O`, `D`, `B` or `L`; absent for the whole tooth.

tooth.description: FDI tooth number: 11-48, or 51-85 for primary teeth.

timezone.description: IANA time zone; `Asia/Kolkata` is the only one supported.

upi_id.description: UPI ID shown on bills, such as `clinic@okicici`.

ClinicSettingsChanges.description:
Changes to the settings. Settings left out stay as they are; an empty string clears an
optional one. Branding changes only the keys given; a given address replaces the whole
address.

gstin.description: GSTIN, checked including its check character.

phone.description: The main branch's phone; +91 is assumed without a country code.

prescription_footer.description: Footer printed on prescriptions, up to 500 characters.

ClinicalFlags.description:
Patient 360's safety banner. Anyone who can see the patient learns that flags exist and how
many; the substances and conditions need `clinical.read`.

details_hidden.description: True when the lists below were left out because the role lacks `clinical.read`.

severe_allergy.description: Whether any active allergy is severe.

Code.description: An optional clinical code. Free text always works without one.

code.description: The code; empty clears it on an edit.

Condition.description: A condition on the problem list.

flagged.description: Shown in the clinical flags banner while active.

verified_by.description: The member who recorded or last confirmed it.

visit_id.description: The visit it was found in.

ConditionFields.description: A condition to record or edit. On an edit, fields left out stay as they are.

display_text.description: What the doctor wrote, 1 to 300 characters; required for a new condition.

flagged.description: Show in the clinical flags banner while active (diabetes, a bleeding disorder, pregnancy).

note.description: A remark, or empty to clear it.

onset.description: When it began (`YYYY-MM-DD`), or empty to clear it.

visit_id.description: The visit it was found in; new conditions only.

CreatedClinic.description: A clinic just created. `invite_token` is shown once; only its hash is stored.

invite_token.description: The invitation secret, for the link sent to the owner.

CreatedInvitation.description: An invitation just sent. `invite_token` is shown once; only its hash is stored.

invite_token.description:
The secret for the invitation link (`https://<clinic host>/invite#<token>`), also
emailed to the invitee.

DentalChart.description: A patient's dental chart. Teeth without entries are absent: draw them as sound.

current.description: The current entries, by tooth (the whole-tooth entry first, then surfaces).

history.description: Every entry of the requested tooth, newest first; empty unless `tooth` was given.

auth_uid.description: The person's Supabase Auth id (`users.auth_uid`), from the local seed.

email.description: A verified email to put in the token, for accepting invitations.

DownloadLink.description: A short-lived link to a file.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working (RFC 3339), five minutes from now.

url.description: Path to fetch on the same clinic host, with the signed token; no sign-in header needed.

email_provider.description: `resend`, or `log` when no Resend key is configured.

retrying.description: Failed, to be tried again later.

EnteredInError.description: Why a record is being marked entered in error.

HourBar.description: Appointments starting in one local hour.

line.description: Line in the file (the header is line 1).

valid.description: Whether the row is (or was) imported.

clinics.description: Clinics they are invited to or active in, by name.

branches.description: Branches they work at; empty means every branch.

MemberBranch.description: A branch a member works at.

MemberChanges.description: A change to a member. Fields left out stay as they are.

MyClinic.description: A clinic the person belongs to.

role_key.description: The person's role there, such as `doctor`.

MySession.description: A device or browser where the person is signed in.

current.description: Whether this is the session making the request.

last_active_at.description: When it was last used, to within a few minutes (RFC 3339).

branch_id.description: Branch; the room's, or the default branch.

ends_at.description: End (RFC 3339), 5 minutes to 12 hours after the start.

reason.description: Reason for the visit, up to 200 characters.

visit_id.description: The open visit they were found in, if any.

surface.description: `M`, `O`, `D`, `B` or `L`; leave out for the whole tooth (crown, missing, implant, root canal and bridge are whole-tooth only).

tooth.description: FDI tooth number: 11-48, or 51-85 for primary teeth.

owner_email.description: The owner's email; they are invited as the clinic owner.

slug.description: The subdomain; derived from the name when absent.

email.description: Their email; they sign in with it to accept.

role_key.description: The role they will get, such as `doctor`.

age_years.description: Age in years when the date of birth is unknown.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth (`YYYY-MM-DD`); give this or `age_years`.

phone.description: Phone; +91 is assumed without a country code.

visit_id.description: The visit it is proposed in.

allOf.description: What and where; taken from the plan item when left out.

plan_item_id.description: An accepted treatment plan item this carries out; when done, the item is done too.

price_paise.description: The fee in paise; the plan item's estimate when left out.

supersedes_id.description: An earlier reading of the same patient and kind that this one corrects.

unit.description: The unit; the kind's usual unit when left out (`Cel` for temperature, which also takes `[degF]`).

value.description: The value; checked against a plausible range for the kind and unit.

NewReadings.description: Readings taken together, such as a blood pressure pair and a pulse.

recorded_at.description: When they were taken (RFC 3339); now when left out.

appointment_id.description: The appointment the patient came for; a walk-in has none. One visit per appointment.

chief_complaint.description: Why the patient came, up to 1,000 characters.

Note.description:
A clinical note. Signed notes never change: corrections go in addenda, and a mistaken note
is marked `entered_in_error` with a reason.

author.description: Who wrote it; only they may edit or sign it.

conflicts_with_id.description: For a conflict: the signed note it collided with.

error_reason.description: Why it was marked entered in error.

status.description: `draft`, `signed`, `conflict` (collided with a signed note during sync) or `entered_in_error`.

NoteContent.description: A note's content. Sections are replaced as a whole when editing.

sections.description: The sections, each up to 10,000 characters.

NoteSections.description: A note's sections. Each may be empty while drafting; signing needs at least one.

Observation.description:
A measurement. Values never change: a correction is a new reading whose `supersedes_id`
names the old one, which stays with status `corrected`.

error_reason.description: Why it was marked entered in error.

value.description: The value, to two decimal places.

visit_id.description: The visit it was taken in.

Patient.description: A patient. Phone and email are masked (`+91******3210`) unless the role has `patients.contact`.

birth_date_estimated.description: Whether the date of birth was estimated from an age.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth (`YYYY-MM-DD`), exact or estimated.

last_visit_at.description: The last visit (RFC 3339), once visits exist.

PatientBrief.description: A patient as the calendar and queue show them.

PatientChanges.description:
Changes to a patient. Fields left out stay as they are; an empty `phone`, `email` or
`date_of_birth` clears it.

age_years.description: Age in years when the date of birth is unknown.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth (`YYYY-MM-DD`), or empty to clear it; give this or `age_years`.

email.description: Email, or empty to clear it; needs `patients.contact`.

phone.description: Phone, or empty to clear it; needs `patients.contact`.

PatientIdentifier.description: Another number a patient is known by.

csv.description: The CSV text, header line first; at most 5,000 rows and 2 MB.

mapping.description:
Our field to the file's column header (matched ignoring case). Fields: `full_name`
(required), `sex`, `date_of_birth`, `age_years`, `phone`, `email`,
`preferred_language`, `file_number`, `legacy_id`.

mode.description: `preview` checks every row and saves nothing; `commit` saves the valid rows.

Plan.description: A treatment plan with its estimate.

estimate_paise.description: The sum of the items that aren't cancelled, in paise.

visit_id.description: The visit it was proposed in.

PlanItem.description: A step of a treatment plan.

PlanList.description: A patient's treatment plans, newest first.

membership_id.description: Their membership, if they sign in.

PractitionerBrief.description: A doctor as the calendar shows them.

PractitionerFields.description:
A doctor to add, or changes to one. Fields left out stay as they are; an empty
`membership_id`, `registration_number` or `specialty` clears it.

active.description: Whether they can be booked (default true).

display_name.description: Name shown on the calendar, 1 to 120 characters; required when adding.

membership_id.description: The member who is this doctor.

Procedure.description:
A procedure planned or done in a visit. Done procedures never change; a mistaken one is
marked `entered_in_error` with a reason.

error_reason.description: Why it was marked entered in error.

plan_item_id.description: The treatment plan item it carries out.

appointment_id.description: The appointment; none for a walk-in.

called_at.description: When the patient was called in (RFC 3339).

done_at.description: When they were done or left (RFC 3339).

token_number.description: Number shown on the screen; restarts at 1 each day per branch.

wait_minutes.description: Minutes waited: until now while waiting, otherwise until called.

is_template.description: Whether it is one of the standard roles.

items.description: Standard roles first, then by name.

RoomFields.description: A room to add, or changes to one. Fields left out stay as they are (or take the default).

active.description: Whether it can be booked (default true).

branch_id.description: Branch; the default branch when adding without one.

name.description: Name, 1 to 60 characters; required when adding.

SavedAppointment.description: An appointment after a booking or change.

warnings.description: Warnings; empty when all is well.

SearchRequest.description: What to search for. Sent in the body, never the URL: search terms are names and phone numbers.

q.description:
A number (`SD-1042` or `1042`), a phone number, or the start of a name. Empty lists
the most recently registered patients.

ServiceMetrics.description: Service health for the console dashboard.

api.description: This instance's API requests, error rates and latency.

db.description: Database connections, cache hit ratio, size, tables and slow statements.

edge.description: Edge and front-end numbers from Cloudflare; `null` until connected.

SessionClinic.description: The clinic the portal runs in.

SessionMembership.description: The member's place in the clinic.

permissions.description: Permission keys the role holds, such as `patients.read`.

invitations.description: Invitations neither accepted nor expired, newest first.

members.description: Members, active first, then by name.

reason.description: Why; required to cancel, up to 200 characters.

StatusChanged.description: An appointment after a status change.

queue_token_id.description: Its queue token, once the patient has arrived.

appointments.description: Appointments today, not counting cancelled ones.

Timeline.description: A page of a patient's timeline, newest first.

TimelineEvent.description: One event on a patient's timeline.

amount_paise.description: The fee in paise, for procedures.

at.description: When it happened (RFC 3339): a visit's start, a note's signing, a procedure's doing.

detail.description: More detail: the chief complaint, the assessment, the tooth or the caption.

id.description: The record: open it through its own route.

title.description: A short title: the visit number, the note kind, the procedure name or the file kind.

booked.description: Booked or confirmed, not arrived yet.

total.description: Appointments today, not counting cancelled ones.

TodayResponse.description: Today at the clinic. Money tiles arrive with billing.

appointments.description: Today's appointments by start, cancelled ones included.

as_of.description: When this was built (RFC 3339); waits are measured from here.

attention.description: Late arrivals and long waits, longest first.

by_hour.description: Appointments per local hour, for hours that have any.

chairs.description: Each active chair: who is in it and who is next.

recent_patients.description: The latest patients through the queue today, newest first.
